name: The Scepter of Celebras

faq.answer: Celebras the Redeemed seeks aid while he works to craft the scepter.
Celebras is crafting the Scepter of Celebras through a special ritual.
faq.q: What is Celebras trying to make?

aliases: what do i do during the ritual
faq.answer: You stand by Celebras the Redeemed to protect and support him until the casting finishes.
faq.q: What is needed during the ritual?

sections.body: Celebras the Redeemed prepares to fashion a relic of his own name. A ritual of creation demands steady hands and vigilant watch, leaving him vulnerable until the work concludes. Once the casting is finished, you are to speak with him to claim the finished staff.
sections.title: A Ritual of Creation

summary: Celebras the Redeemed calls for your aid to forge the Scepter of Celebras. You must stand guard beside him while the delicate rite takes place and speak with him once the power settles.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Scepter of Celebras
